records.failureSummary: Added src/components/__tests__/listErrorRetry.spec.ts (3 tests, markers [AC-19] [AC-20]) covering FR-4.3/FR-4.4: a stubbed globalThis.fetch holds every request open, the first GET is answered 500 { error: { code: 'INTERNAL' } }, retry GETs are scripted per request; assertions use only data-testid selectors, element containment, data-done/textContent, plus a console.error spy, a process unhandledRejection listener and a window error listener. Results: 2 passed, 1 failed. Passed: [AC-19] [AC-20] first GET 500 shows a visible error-banner that contains exactly one retry-button and renders 0 task-item (no empty-state invented, no loading-indicator left); [AC-19] [AC-20] clicking retry-button issues a second GET on the same list URL and on 200 { items: 3 } hides the banner, renders exactly 3 task-item in payload order and task-count text equal to \"3\". Failed (exact): 'AssertionError: expected [] to deeply equal [ 保留已有任务 ]' at listErrorRetry.spec.ts:384 in '[AC-19] [AC-20] a retry that fails again keeps error-banner with retry-button and does not clear the task already on the board' - the banner and its retry-button are still rendered, but the task already on the board is gone. Cause is product code, not the test: src/views/TaskBoardView.vue loadTasks() calls taskStore.clearTasks() in its catch block, so a failed list load wipes existing tasks, contradicting TR-4.7 ('失败时不得清空已有 tasks') and the UI state 'list-error-retained' ('重试仍失败时保持 error 状态且不清空已有 tasks') that this task's acceptance criterion 4 restates. I did not modify product code, per the anti-tamper rule, so this needs a FRONTEND task. Also independently of my work, src/__tests__/app-shell-states.spec.ts:274-275 still asserts that a failed load renders NO error-banner and NO retry-button, which is irreconcilable with AC-19 and keeps the full suite red; that stale assertion is a TEST-task fix. lint (exit 0), typecheck (exit 0) and no new dependencies; no real network and no mock control-plane endpoint is touched. The named deliverable path src/components/__tests__/listErrorRetry.spec.ts was accepted by the write policy.
